```{r}
#| results: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
library(commonmark)

works_data <- read_csv("works/works.csv")

# Function to convert markdown to HTML
render_markdown <- function(text) {
  HTML(markdown_html(text))
}

# Functions to construct paths (for presentation-type entries)
make_slides_path <- function(name) {
  paste0("https://pingfan-hu.github.io/", name, "/")
}

make_pdf_path <- function(name) {
  paste0(file.path("/works", name), ".pdf")
}

make_github_path <- function(name) {
  paste0("https://github.com/pingfan-hu/", name)
}

# A labeled pill action button (icon + text)
pres_button <- function(href, icon, label) {
  a(
    href = href,
    class = "pres-btn",
    target = "_blank",
    rel = "noopener noreferrer",
    tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon)),
    tags$span(label)
  )
}

# Paper document buttons, built from the explicit link columns in the CSV.
# The icon is inferred from the label (PDF vs. other document).
paper_doc_buttons <- function(Doc1Label, Doc1URL, Doc2Label, Doc2URL) {
  make <- function(label, url) {
    if (is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) return(NULL)
    icon <- if (grepl("pdf", tolower(label))) "bi-file-earmark-pdf" else "bi-file-earmark-text"
    pres_button(url, icon, label)
  }
  Filter(Negate(is.null), list(make(Doc1Label, Doc1URL), make(Doc2Label, Doc2URL)))
}

# Nested APA reference block (papers only) with a copy button (top-right).
pub_reference <- function(reference) {
  if (is.na(reference) || !nzchar(reference)) return(NULL)
  div(
    class = "pub-ref",
    tags$button(
      class = "pub-ref-copy",
      type = "button",
      `aria-label` = "Copy reference",
      tags$i(class = "bi bi-clipboard")
    ),
    div(class = "pub-ref-text", render_markdown(reference))
  )
}

# Create a work card. Buttons and date format depend on the type.
create_work <- function(Date, Title, Event, Location, Name, Type = "slide",
                               Doc1Label = NA, Doc1URL = NA, Doc2Label = NA, Doc2URL = NA,
                               Reference = NA) {
  pub_type <- if (is.null(Type) || is.na(Type)) "slide" else tolower(Type)

  actions <- if (pub_type == "slide") {
    list(
      pres_button(make_slides_path(Name), "bi-easel", "Slides"),
      pres_button(make_pdf_path(Name), "bi-file-earmark-pdf", "PDF"),
      pres_button(make_github_path(Name), "bi-github", "GitHub")
    )
  } else if (pub_type %in% c("workshop", "storybook")) {
    list(
      pres_button(make_slides_path(Name), "bi-globe", "Website"),
      pres_button(make_github_path(Name), "bi-github", "GitHub")
    )
  } else if (pub_type == "paper") {
    paper_doc_buttons(Doc1Label, Doc1URL, Doc2Label, Doc2URL)
  } else {
    # Single PDF button for Poster
    list(pres_button(make_pdf_path(Name), "bi-file-earmark-pdf", "PDF"))
  }

  # Papers show the year only; storybooks month + year; everything else full.
  date_fmt <- switch(pub_type,
    storybook = "%B, %Y",
    paper     = "%Y",
    "%B %d, %Y"
  )

  div(
    class = "presentation-box",
    div(
      class = "presentation-content",
      div(class = "presentation-title", Title),
      div(
        class = "presentation-details",
        div(class = "event-location", render_markdown(Event)),
        div(
          class = "presentation-date",
          tags$i(class = "bi bi-calendar3"),
          format(Date, date_fmt)
        )
      )
    ),
    if (pub_type == "paper") pub_reference(Reference) else NULL,
    div(class = "presentation-actions", actions)
  )
}

# Build the work cards for a filtered data frame
build_works <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return(list())
  pmap(data, create_work)
}

storybook_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "storybook") %>%
  build_works()

workshop_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "workshop") %>%
  build_works()

paper_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "paper") %>%
  build_works()

slide_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(is.na(Type) | tolower(Type) == "slide") %>%
  build_works()

poster_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "poster") %>%
  build_works()

# Wrap a group of cards under an editorial section header:
# a small icon chip + Maple Mono label + a thin hairline rule. The `variant`
# class carries the section's soft accent color (see styles.scss). `slug`
# is the scroll anchor id used by the category locator.
work_section <- function(title, icon, items, variant, slug) {
  div(
    class = paste("pres-section", variant),
    id = slug,
    div(
      class = "pres-section-head",
      span(class = "pres-section-icon", tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon))),
      span(class = "pres-section-title", title),
      span(class = "pres-section-rule")
    ),
    div(class = "pres-section-body", items)
  )
}

# A category locator link (icon + label): a table-of-contents-style anchor that
# smooth-scrolls to its section. Carries the section's variant class so it
# themes with that section's accent color.
nav_link <- function(label, icon, slug, variant) {
  a(
    href = paste0("#", slug),
    class = paste("pres-filter-btn", variant),
    `data-target` = slug,
    tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon)),
    tags$span(label)
  )
}

# Single source of truth for the sections — drives both the locator and the
# rendered sections, and drops any category that has no entries.
sections <- list(
  list(title = "Workshops",  icon = "bi-people",            items = workshop_works,  variant = "pres-teal",   slug = "workshops"),
  list(title = "Storybooks", icon = "bi-journal-bookmark",  items = storybook_works, variant = "pres-rose",   slug = "storybooks"),
  list(title = "Papers",     icon = "bi-file-earmark-text", items = paper_works,     variant = "pres-violet", slug = "papers"),
  list(title = "Slides",     icon = "bi-easel",             items = slide_works,     variant = "pres-blue",   slug = "slides"),
  list(title = "Posters",    icon = "bi-image",             items = poster_works,    variant = "pres-amber",  slug = "posters")
)
sections <- Filter(function(s) length(s$items) > 0, sections)

filter_box <- tags$aside(
  class = "pres-filter",
  div(class = "pres-filter-title", "Categories"),
  tags$nav(
    class = "pres-filter-list",
    lapply(sections, function(s) nav_link(s$title, s$icon, s$slug, s$variant))
  )
)

section_cards <- lapply(sections, function(s) {
  work_section(s$title, s$icon, s$items, s$variant, s$slug)
})
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
div(
  class = "presentations-page",
  filter_box,
  div(class = "pres-main", section_cards)
)
```
